2119588338193555490.en_summary: $QQQ Trade Ideas. Bullish: Nov 11 665C Trigger: 661. Bearish: Nov 11 650P Trigger: 653. QQQ has dropped 15% from the all time highs. It dropped 6.5% last Thursday alone. Usually when we see this type of price action like last Thursday, a bottom will start to form over the next week. Let’s see if QQQ backtests 637 then moves higher. If QQQ can reclaim 661 and hold this level for 3-4 trading days we should see a move higher to 700 this month. QQQ 630-637 range should be the bottom.
